errors.text: The required 12x12x12, 3456-atom supercell is replaced by an unsupported >10,000-atom requirement derived from unrelated low-temperature SRO and thermal-conductivity work.
The hypothesis predicts SRO stabilization below 1 meV/atom and negligible melting impact, contradicting the target result of approximately 2.4 meV/atom and a non-negligible approximately 25 K shift.
Electronic-excitation shifts are understated as 10-20 K instead of the target 48 K for GGA-PBE and 57 K for LDA.
The proposed melting point of 2250 K and uncertainty below 5 K are unsupported and do not reconstruct the reported relationship to CALPHAD, including the 193 K and 160 K deficits for GGA-PBE and LDA.

FEP is described as perturbing directly between solid and liquid states; the relevant mechanism is perturbation from the MTP reference to DFT within sampled phase ensembles, with small MTP-DFT energy-difference variance.
